messages:
Clara H.: quick standup \, marketplace listing + SI launch next week. Final gates: partner-approved hero + quote, blog draft, screenshots + short demo clip, embargo owner, localized CTAs (EN/FR/DE), and post-launch dashboard. Target publish = Thu Jun 5. Who owns what? :spiral_calendar:

Ben K.: I'll own the blog + partner quote. Need partner comms contact and a 1-2 sentence quote by Tue COB. Draft to be shared Tue AM.

Isha V.: taking landing hero + CTAs and localization. Proposal hero: "Run predictable, low-latency LLMs with EdgeCloud". CTAs: `Try in your cloud` / `Request EU demo` / `Quickstart`. Will add FR/DE variants.

Sam P.: infra + staging here. infra-bot, please provision a staging tenant with limited tokens and send creds to Ben + Isha. Also will capture latency runs for the listing.

infra-bot: Staging tenant provisioned: rwd-edgecloud-launch-stg-0605. Creds emailed to Ben K., Isha V. (expires 72h).

Ben K.: thanks infra-bot. For screenshots + demo clip I want 3 short assets: hero banner, 90s demo (screen + terminal), and latency table screenshot. Can someone script the demo steps?

Isha V.: I'll create screenshot script and sample prompts. Example prompt set: `announce_summary`, `policy_check`, `vector_search_example`. Adding scripts to shared drive.

Clara H.: embargo plan: partner prefers Thu 23:59 PT if legal approves. Legal deadline = Wed 12:00 PT. If legal misses, fallback = publish Fri morning. Ben, set blog publish to conditional in CMS.

Ben K.: will set conditional flag and draft social blurb. Placeholder blog link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/2EdgeCloudLaunch (will update).

Sam P.: demo script sketch:

```
# demo steps (approx 6 min)
1) Verify staging tenant + API key
2) Run inference (rw-accelerate) for a short summary
3) Run embeddings search against the sample dataset
4) Capture latency table (5 runs avg)
```

Isha V.: screenshot curl example:

```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY' \\
  -d '{"model":"rw-accelerate","input":"Summarize the EdgeCloud partnership in two sentences"}'
```

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run invite sent for 2024-06-03T00:00:00Z (Mon 17:00 PT).

Clara H.: dry run attendees = partner SI tech lead, partner comms, legal rep, product + infra. Plan to record demo and ask partner to verify screenshots during dry run.

Ben K.: partner quote blocker: partner PR asked to review screenshot frames before giving quote. We'll include them in the dry run and mark any edits.

Isha V.: localization: will upload EN/FR/DE CTAs to drive and tag copy lines needing legal review. For EMEA listing we'll show `Request EU demo` by default for .eu visitors.

Sam P.: perf numbers: I'll run 3 model variants (rw-accelerate, rw-base-v2, embeddings-lite) with warmup and measure avg + p95. Will post numbers to runbook before dry run.

Clara H.: owners recap -> Blog & partner quote: Ben K.; Landing hero + localization: Isha V.; Staging infra & metrics: Sam P.; Legal & embargo coordination: Clara H. If anyone needs to swap, ping now.

Ben K.: small ask: can we get a partner-facing one-pager (key benefits + metrics) for comms? Isha, can you draft a 1-pager?

Isha V.: yes, I'll draft the one-pager and include sample latency bullets and CTAs.

Clara H.: perfect. I'll consolidate the final checklist after the dry run and post the timeline. Thanks team :rocket:
